notes.title: Non-Game Update. Trading Cards released
notes.content:
Hello dear players,

Since the publisher of app is changed and we are new owners of app, we would like to inform that we added Trading Cards in Dungeons of Betrayal, it's just a small "thank you" for all players who supported this project.

Thanks again

Here is some preivew of cards:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30159750/6df12dd595ace5ad118f32e46e27e45a1ff2f9e0.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE - v.1.0.2
notes.content:
Recent changes (v.1.0.2):
- Fixed a major bug where the party could automatically level up to lv.99 on the final boss
- Adjusted some characters illustrations that were overlapping text boxes
- Fixed a bug where characters were walking through walls in some Garik-Hollow houses
- Fixed the spinning chests in Garik-Hollow
- Removed a few place holder texts
- Added some interactions with signs and objects

Extras: 
The game can now be played in Spanish (only on Windows for now). You can change the language from the game properties in your Steam Client. Please note that this is experimental as we do not officially support Spanish. Feel free to report any bugs or spelling mistakes in our Steam Community section.


Previous changes (v.1.0.1):
- Added story dialog
- Minor optimization
- Updated the Credits
- Minor bug fixes
